evals.expected_output: Claude verifies WSL via powershell.exe, locates the playbook repo (checking $CLAUDE_PLAYBOOK_DIR then falling back to ~/git_repos/dmt-scripts-claude_ai_playbook), pulls latest changes, runs make sync, and reports that both WSL and Windows ~/.claude directories have been updated.
assertions: Claude checks for powershell.exe using 'command -v powershell.exe' before proceeding
Claude checks $CLAUDE_PLAYBOOK_DIR before falling back to the default path
Claude runs git pull before running make sync
Claude runs make sync to update both WSL and Windows config
Claude reports whether the pull fetched new commits
Claude reminds the user to restart Claude Code to pick up changes

evals.expected_output: Claude detects it is not running in WSL (powershell.exe not found) and stops, instructing the user to run the skill from a WSL terminal.
assertions: Claude runs 'command -v powershell.exe' as the first action
Claude stops immediately when powershell.exe is not found
Claude tells the user to open a WSL terminal and try again

evals.expected_output: Claude resolves the repo path from the $CLAUDE_PLAYBOOK_DIR environment variable (not the fallback path), pulls changes, and runs make sync.
assertions: Claude uses $CLAUDE_PLAYBOOK_DIR as the repo path when the variable is set
Claude does not use the fallback path when $CLAUDE_PLAYBOOK_DIR is set
Claude verifies the resolved path exists before proceeding
